name: Financial Curses
overview: Scripture reveals that blessings and curses are closely connected to obedience and relationship with God, as seen in His promise to bless those who bless His people and curse those who oppose them (Genesis 12:3). Financial provision is ultimately from the Lord, who grants the power to gain wealth to uphold His covenant (Deuteronomy 8:18). The faithful are encouraged to honor God through faithful stewardship and tithing, with the assurance that He will open the windows of heaven to pour out abundant blessings (Malachi 3:10). While the reality of hardship is acknowledged (Ecclesiastes 6:1), God's unchanging nature ensures His covenantal faithfulness, preventing His people from being consumed by curses (Malachi 3:6).
